description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting, which implements a strategy for fixing the nesting of HTML tokens to ensure they conform to HTML specifications. It performs tree arborization, traverses nodes to validate and correct nesting, and handles exclusions and error reporting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting
classes.description: A class that implements a strategy to fix the nesting of HTML tokens by verifying and correcting their hierarchy according to HTML rules.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes a list of tokens, rebuilds the tree, validates and corrects nesting, and returns the fixed token list.
